verdict.label: Full review
verdict.summary: Creating a Meta Ads OAuth app requires registering as a developer, connecting a business portfolio, and completing App Review and Business Verification before production users can connect.
verdict.cost: Free to create and test; requires a business portfolio and optional Business Verification.

composioFit.summary: Composio provides a managed OAuth app for METAADS so you can start testing immediately without app registration, or you can bring your own app for dedicated provider rate limits and custom scopes.
whyOwnApp: Dedicated provider rate limits instead of sharing with other Composio customers
Your own scopes beyond what Composio's managed app requests

phases.name: Register and Create App
steps: Register as a Meta developer and log into your developer account.
Navigate to https://developers.facebook.com/apps/creation/ to begin app creation.
Enter your app's name and contact email address, then select use cases and a business portfolio.
phases.handoff: App ID and App Secret obtained.

phases.name: Development and Testing
steps: Configure use cases and permissions in development mode.
Test authentication and API calls using roles on the app.

phases.name: App Review and Business Verification
steps: Submit required permissions and features for App Review.

artefacts.title: Meta App Creation Form
artefacts.body:
App Name: AI Agent Integration
Contact Email: developer@example.com
Redirect URI: <Composio callback URL from your auth config>

artefacts.title: Scope Justification Statement
artefacts.body: Our AI agent requests advertising and business management permissions solely to retrieve ad campaign metrics, manage ad performance, and execute ad creation workflows requested by the authorized business user.

requirements.label: Business Verification
requirements.when: Required if your app requests advanced access for permissions or allows other businesses to access their own data.

requirements.label: Privacy Policy URL
requirements.when: Always required in the App Dashboard settings.

requirements.label: App Review Demo Video
requirements.when: Required during App Review to show how your app uses the requested permissions.

scopes.purpose: Manages business assets and portfolio access.
Shows list of Facebook pages associated with the business.

redirectRules.rule: Graph API and redirect endpoints require HTTPS.

blockers.symptom: User request limit reached. 613, Error subcode: 1487742, Message: There have been too many calls from this ad-account.
blockers.cause: Exceeded the ad account rate limit score threshold.
blockers.fix: Implement exponential backoff and throttle API calls.
blockers.fallback: Upgrade to Full Access tier of Marketing API Access Tier.

blockers.symptom: Unable to create an application or accept a new pending role.
blockers.cause: Reached the limit of having a developer or administrator role on a maximum of 15 apps not connected to a Meta Verified Business Account.
blockers.fix: Connect a verified business portfolio to unused apps or remove yourself as an admin/developer from old apps.

blockers.symptom: error_code = 4, CodeException (error subcode: 1504022), error_title: Too many API requests
blockers.cause: Sent too many complex or high-frequency queries to the Ads Insights API endpoint.
blockers.fix: Spread queries by pacing them with wait times and check the x-fb-ads-insights-throttle header.
blockers.fallback: Use asynchronous ad report run jobs for large data volumes.

checklist.text: Register as a Meta developer and log in.
Navigate to the app creation page and enter app details.
Select required use cases and a business portfolio.
Configure redirect URIs and scopes in the App Dashboard.
Test login and API integration with development accounts.
Submit permissions for App Review and switch app to Live mode.

uncertainties: Exact approval duration for App Review is not specified in the documentation.
Specific pricing tiers for Marketing API Full Access are not detailed beyond call volume thresholds.

claims.text: The revised qualification threshold for Full Access to the Marketing API has been reduced from 1,500 to 500 Marketing API calls in the past 15 days.
claims.quote: The revised qualification threshold for Full Access has been reduced from 1,500 to **500 Marketing API calls** in the past 15 days.

claims.text: If an app is in the Marketing API development tier, its maximum rate limit score is 60 with a decay rate of 300 seconds and a 300-second block duration.
claims.quote: If your app is in the Marketing API development tier: | * Your maximum score is 60. | * The decay rate is 300 seconds. | * You will be blocked for 300 seconds if you reach the maximum score.

claims.text: If an app has Full access to the Marketing API, its maximum rate limit score is 9,000 with a decay rate of 300 seconds and a 60-second block duration.
claims.quote: If your app has Full access to the Marketing API: | * Your maximum score is 9000. | * The decay rate is 300 seconds. | * You will be blocked for 60 seconds if you reach the maximum score.
